subject: Errors running growth on categorical data

messages.author: 5044b2c23945a588
messages.subject: Errors running growth on categorical data
parts:
Hi all,

I'm a bit of a newbie to lavaan, and have jumped into the deep end by trying to run a latent growth curve analysis on some panel data. I have been coming across a few problems, and wondered if anyone could help me diagnose them. The data is a binary outcome (economically active or not) at 3 time points. I'm also adding in other latent variables as time-independent predictors of intercept and slope, and some time-varying covariates too. My model code is:

M1 <- '
#Intercept and slope of time-varying DV
intercept =~ 1*Activity_t1 + 1*Activity_t2 + 1*Activity_t3
slope =~ 0*Activity_t1 + 1*Activity_t2 + 2*Activity_t3

#Other latent variables
lv1 =~ lv1_measure1
lv2 =~ lv2_measure1 + lv2_measure2 + lv2_measure3 + lv2_measure4 + lv2_measure5
lv3 =~ lv3_measure1
lv4 =~ lv4_measure1

#Regressions
intercept ~ lv1 + lv2 + lv3 + lv4
slope ~ lv1 + lv2 + lv3 + lv4

#Time-varying covariates
Activity_t1 ~ cv1_t1 + cv2_t1 + cv3_t1
Activity_t2 ~ cv1_t2 + cv2_t2 + cv3_t2 + cv4_t2
Activity_t3 ~ cv2_t3
'

Note that Activity_t1, Activity_t2, Activity_t3 are binary factors, but are set to ordered prior to the analyses. Also, lv3_measure1, lv4_measure1, cv3_t1, and cv3_t2 are categorical variables.

The issue is that, when running:
>fit_M1 <- growth(M1, df, group = "sex")

I get:
Warning messages: 
1: In lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats, :
  lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors!
  lavaan NOTE: this may be a symptom that the model is not identified.

2: In lav_model_test(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavpartable = lavpartable, :
  lavaan WARNING: could not compute scaled test statistic

3: In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: some estimated ov variances are negative

4: In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: some estimated lv variances are negative

The model itself runs, but obviously something is wrong, and the summary looks pretty bare. I presume there is a problem with the syntax itself, but there seems to be a lack of examples/tutorials using growth curve analysis for categorical data, other than the page on the lavaan website itself. If anyone has any suggestions of where to start debugging this, that'd be great.

Thanks in advance!

Matthew

messages.subject: Re: Errors running growth on categorical data
parts: I presume there is a problem with the syntax itself, but there seems to be a lack of examples/tutorials using growth curve analysis for categorical data, other than the page on the lavaan website itself. If anyone has any suggestions of where to start debugging this, that'd be great.

Your covariance structure is just-identified, but I don't know if your mean structure is identified (not that the 2 are independent of each other when you have categorical data).  I'd suggest reading this article:

http://dx.doi.org/10.1037/1082-989X.9.3.301

and try fitting the growth-model part alone (only add predictors once you know your model is identified).  Then if you still have trouble identifying your model, try asking on SEMNET (since it is a general SEM problem, not specific to lavaan).  Jason Newsom's book on longitudinal SEM is excellent and should be helpful here, and he is also on SEMNET and might see your post.  If you still have trouble fitting a growth curve model that should be identified, try posting your syntax (and maybe data) here again.
